objective:
Goal: the Markdown file is shown with formatting applied. Reach it from the current page by clicking through the visible UI, by any route. Never type a URL or use the address bar.
Hint: an old tutorial said "If you are viewing a Markdown file, above the file content, you can also click Preview to return to the view with Markdown formatting applied.", but those labels may have moved or been renamed.
When the goal is met, store the main heading of the page you end on as 'landed_on', then verify the goal on screen.

actions.intent: PRIMARY: navigate from the current page to the Markdown file with formatting applied; role=link; text="Readme.md" | HINTS: container=Folders and files table
actions.instr: Clicking Readme.md in the folders and files list

actions.intent: PRIMARY: wait for the Markdown file with formatting applied to finish loading
actions.instr: Waiting for the formatted Markdown file to finish loading

actions.intent: whether the Markdown file with formatting applied is present (in the Readme.md article)
actions.instr: Checking whether the Markdown file is shown with formatting applied
